ideas.pitch: A Discord bot built with Caspian that automatically extracts study notes, generates daily quizzes, and tracks study streaks for student peer groups to maximize active daily usage.
ideas.title: StudyScribe Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting message volume and usage criteria (40% of score) by embedding directly into active student study servers with high daily engagement.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous engineering standup bot that collects daily updates from team members via DMs, formats blockers into an aggregated summary, and pings devs to maintain consistent daily usage.
ideas.title: DevStandup Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly optimizes for active days and message volume by integrating into development team workflows where consistent usage is guaranteed.

ideas.pitch: A gaming guild community agent that manages member rosters, schedules raids, and tracks internal resource pooling with automated reminders inside community Discord channels.
ideas.title: GuildTreasurer Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages gaming communities known for generating extremely high daily message volumes and consistent engagement spikes.

ideas.pitch: A restaurant group reservation and lunch-ordering agent deployed in local community chat groups, handling real-time polling and multi-user meal coordination daily.
ideas.title: LocalBites Concierge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a real-world coordination problem with a creative use case that hits the impact and creativity judging metrics.

ideas.pitch: A GitHub-linked Discord agent that greets new pull requests, assigns reviewers, and prompts developers with daily reminders to clear their code review backlogs.
ideas.title: CodeReview Buddy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines developer tooling utility with high-frequency engagement metrics, ensuring consistent interaction throughout the challenge window.
